title: LOCATION-Hot Tub-Clean WALK TO BARS in❤️of EastNash
description:
JUST ADDED: HOT TUB, SCREENED PORCH WITH FIREPLACE, HALF BATH. 
Location. Location. Location. Totally renovated charming 1930 cottage with 2 bdrms/2.5 bath. (1 queen bed and 1 king) Walking distance to bars/restaurants/shops and 2 miles from "Broadway" Nashville! (A $8.00 Uber ride) Equipped kitchen. Extremely clean and spacious! Large outdoor screened-in porch with stone fireplace and 55” TV. A second fire pit in the front of house. Ideal for relaxing and grilling!

The space
Adorable renovated 1930 home with easy access to everything Nashville has to offer!

Thank you!

Other things to note
The price listed per night includes TN state tax and occupancy tax.

**a neighborhood cat comes and goes. He stays outside and sometimes can be found on backporch. We have named him LEO. He may show up…he may not. I leave food and water for him. He has never been an issue with anyone but you can contact me if he does. Extremely friendly!**

TOP 5 of my favorite restaurants:
1. The Southern (Downtown)
2. St. Anejo (Gulch)
3. Bar Taco (12th South)
4. Chauhaun (Gulch)
5. Germantown Cafe (Germantown)

BARS that are a must:
1. The Stage
2. ROBERTS 
3. Legends
4. Bar Taco (Great Spicy Margaritas-place to be seen)
5. Tin Roof (Demonbreum) 
6. Red Door (Midtown)
7. LOSERS and WINNERS (Midtown)
8. Bar ontop of Westin Hotel (Gulch)
9. LA Jackson Roof top (Gulch)
10. Acme (Broadway)
